title: BHUVAN Flood Inundation — Assam Revenue Circles (Monthly)
description: Monthly flood inundation extent and intensity per Revenue Circle in Assam, derived from BHUVAN disaster-services inundation maps, used as a hazard input to the IDS-DRR Assam flood risk model.
purpose: Input covariate for the IDS-DRR Assam flood risk score model, capturing observed flood inundation extent and intensity.
details: Per the risk model's data dictionary: inundation_pct, inundation_intensity_mean, and inundation_intensity_mean_nonzero are licensed 'GNU General Public License' there (an unusual choice for a data product — GPL is a software license — worth confirming with the team), while inundation_intensity_sum is separately marked 'CC BY 4.0' (its republication license via open-contracting.in). RDLS has one license field per dataset, so the majority value (GPL) is used here. Temporal coverage reflects Sources/master/inundation.csv (2015-06 to 2025-09); 'intensity' is defined by the source as pixel inundation count divided by the maximum pixel inundation count in the given month (a normalized index, not a physical unit).
